skills.description: Traces API endpoint response fields back to database table columns across microservice boundaries (Spring Boot + Spring Cloud Feign + MyBatis). Used when user provides a URL path like /api/user/info and wants complete field-to-database-column mapping, including downstream Feign calls. Always emits a PlantUML (PUML) service-call flowchart using the preferred 'service + its DB in the same box (box grouping) + autonumber call sequence' layout (config-driven DB names via services.json 'databases' section + inject_service_db.py): cross-service calls annotated with caller→callee + Feign path, internal calls traced down to the executed SQL with inline comments, in-service compute/assembly logic explained, and unconfigured downstream services still drawn on the diagram (never omitted). Optional 'risk-code forecast' (风险代码预报) phase: after tracing, review the involved code/SQL against the company Java dev manual (references/risk_rules.md, derived from 《和贵 Java 开发手册》) and optionally run scripts/check_risk.py to flag risky patterns (transaction scope, @Transactional, idempotency, pagination/export limit, MyBatis SQL injection/JOIN/N+1/wrapper pass-through, privilege/over-authorization, concurrency Executors/new Thread, MQ catch-swallow, Feign returns CommonResult, etc.). Trigger: 接口字段溯源, trace API fields, 字段映射, field to db column mapping, 调用流程图, PUML, 服务调用链路, 调用序号, box 分组, 风险预报, 风险代码, 代码评审, 风险扫描, 合规检查. Optional 'report fetch full-process spec' (报表取数全流程说明) phase: after tracing, act as a data engineer + backend dev to produce an independent Markdown that reuses the FULL trace (never trimmed) and documents the COMPLETE data-fetching flow — source-table/source-DB extraction logic (源表/源库取数逻辑: full SQL + in-service judgement/compute/assembly), and a PlantUML '表取数流程图' that embeds the executed SQL logic, judgment logic, and calculation logic. The output contains NO new-table design or ETL write logic — it only keeps the complete fetch full-process as a baseline for later migration/optimization. Equivalent triggers: 报表取数全流程说明, 取数流程图, 取数逻辑说明, 报表迁移, 数据迁移方案, ETL. Emits a standalone '报表取数全流程说明-<api>.md' (template in references/report_migration_plan.md; scaffold via scripts/gen_migration_plan.py). Trigger: 报表取数全流程说明, 取数流程图, 取数逻辑说明, 报表迁移, 数据迁移方案, 生成迁移方案, ETL, 取数逻辑.
